cases.prompt: A live-action IMAX-scale aerial shot races through clouds over hundreds of bronze celestial warships and endless heavenly soldiers toward the South Heavenly Gate, where Sun Wukong stands alone.

assertions.description: A large celestial invasion force with multiple bronze warships, soldiers, and war banners is visible at monumental scale.
A colossal traditional Chinese heavenly gate and palace complex dominates the destination of the camera move.
One lone armored monkey warrior with a crimson cape and long staff stands on the white-jade stairs facing the army.
The shot has readable foreground, middle ground, and deep background with convincing blockbuster scale rather than undifferentiated particles.
No subtitle, logo, watermark, or malformed text is visible.

cases.prompt: A low-angle hero reveal orbits Sun Wukong on shattered jade as his red cape lashes, his staff throws sparks, and a vast heavenly army aims spears behind him under storm clouds.

assertions.description: A single realistic monkey warrior in ornate dark-gold armor, a crimson cape, crown, and long black-and-gold staff is the clear hero subject.
The low-angle composition and visible pose read as a controlled, defiant hero reveal rather than a generic standing figure.
Dense heavenly soldiers and lowered spears visibly surround or threaten the hero in the middle and background.
Lightning, storm clouds, large silhouettes, and layered depth create a monumental mythic-war scale.
No subtitle, logo, watermark, or malformed text is visible.

cases.prompt: Continue from the selected stable frame near the end of the previous shot. The same Sun Wukong crouches, shatters the jade terrace, launches in the same screen direction through soldiers and bronze chariots, then breaks the formation with one golden staff shockwave.

assertions.description: The same red-caped armored monkey warrior is visibly airborne and attacking with one stable long staff.
A large readable formation of celestial soldiers, bronze chariots, weapons, and banners fills the cloud battlefield.
The action visibly parts, scatters, or breaks the formation with a clear golden impact or shockwave.
Motion, anatomy, staff, chariots, and camera direction remain coherent enough to read as one blockbuster action beat.
No subtitle, logo, watermark, malformed text, or gore is visible.

cases.prompt: A mountain-sized Sun Wukong rises through thunderclouds over tiny palace complexes and circling celestial warships, then swings a continent-long staff across the sky.

assertions.description: Sun Wukong is unmistakably mountain-sized while retaining a realistic monkey face, gold armor, crimson cape, crown, and staff.
Tiny palaces, flying warships, armies, or cloud layers provide clear and convincing size references around the giant.
The giant raises or swings one enormous black-and-gold staff across the sky in a powerful readable action.
Thunder, cloud walls, atmospheric depth, and armies create an IMAX disaster-film spectacle rather than a close portrait.
No subtitle, logo, watermark, or malformed text is visible.

cases.prompt: Sun Wukong strikes the colossal South Heavenly Gate; jade palaces and bronze towers fracture in a golden shockwave before the camera resolves on him against the burning ruins.

assertions.description: A staff strike or golden shockwave visibly impacts a colossal traditional Chinese heavenly gate or palace complex.
White-jade stairs, palaces, towers, columns, fire, dust, or ships show a large-scale readable destruction climax.
The shot resolves on one realistic armored monkey warrior with crimson cape and long staff standing before burning heavenly ruins.
The hero retains stable anatomy, face, armor, cape, and a single coherent staff without duplicate parts.
No subtitle, logo, watermark, UI overlay, or malformed generated caption is visible; architectural signage alone is allowed.
